name: Problem Sleuth
storyline: it details the antics of three especially hardboiled detectives—Problem Sleuth, Ace Dick, and Pickle Inspector—in their attempts to get out of their offices, all the while working to aid the turmoil-stricken kingdoms of the Weasels, Clowns, Hogs, and Elves and to foil the dastardly plots of Mobster Kingpin.
summary: Problem Sleuth is a webcomic that started in 2008. is a parody of point-and-click adventure games, jrpg and noir films.
